EC5: Uncontrolled local [OR] or systemic diseases  that affects wound healing (diabetes [OR], autoimmune [OR] or inflammatory disorders)
EC6: Past history of systemic steroid use over 2 weeks within the last 2 years
EC7: Poor oral hygiene on a non-compliant individual
EC9: Anticoagulant therapy [AND] (e.g. Warfarin [OR], Plavix, etc.), will not be automatic exclusion but patients will be required to have INR test performed and have values between 2.0 to 3. Physician consultation will be requested to determine whether anticoagulant therapy can be discontinued for 3 days prior to surgery.
EC10: Objection to blood draw or application of blood products
EC11: Students and staff from USC Ostrow school of Dentistry will not be recruited for this study
